d: Char dinon tak chali aastha, vishvas aur sury upasna ki sadhna aaj udiyman sury ko arghy dene ke sath sanpann ho gaee. dumka men subah se hi chhath ghaton par shraddhaluon ki bhari bhir umri. vratiyon ne bhagvan bhaskar ko arghy arpit kar parivar ki sukh-samriddhi, khushhali aur aarogyata ki kamna ki. shahar ke bara bandh, khunta bandh, pusaro aur dudhani samet aath pramukh ghaton par chhath mahaparv ka aayojan kiya gaya tha. vahin jile ke sabhi das prakhandon men bhi talabon aur nadiyon ke kinare shraddhaluon ne puri shraddha aur bhakti ke sath puja-archana ki. ghaton ki aakarshak sajavat…
